Changes to the Agenda

Public Comment (Non-Agenda Items)

publicComments.name: Emily Dunn
publicComments.summary: Speaking on behalf of about 10 Orion co-op families, she asked the district to consider adding a third TK co-op class to address the large waitlist, suggested moving the CDC preschool off-campus to free classroom space, and raised concerns about upper-grade attrition to North Star undermining Orion's enrollment health.

publicComments.name: Rosalba Rodriguez
publicComments.summary: A McKinley parent speaking in Spanish, she urged the board to retain Student Services Coordinator Mr. Nelson, praising his dedication, support for students, and the personal sacrifices he makes for them.

items.title: Labor Association Comments

publicComments.name: Maria (labor union representative)
publicComments.summary: She urged the board and district management to prioritize in-person meetings over virtual ones when dealing with difficult issues such as labor negotiations, arguing that face-to-face interaction builds stronger bonds and more effective communication.

publicComments.name: Leanne Thompson
publicComments.summary: PTO president at Clifford expressed concern that creating split-grade classes is not sustainable for teachers or equitable for students with varying needs, and urged the board to preserve IEP administrative support so principals can serve as instructional leaders.

publicComments.name: Steve Yike
publicComments.summary: Orion School Site Council chair raised concerns that cutting the guest teacher directly impacts classrooms — especially given Orion's Mandarin program — and questioned whether all district-level cuts had truly been exhausted before making site-based reductions.

publicComments.name: Tina Mercer
publicComments.summary: Roosevelt principal and SRA Committee member thanked Dr. Baker for keeping the heaviest cuts at the district level, expressed appreciation for retaining pre-K–5 IEP administrative support, and noted the half-time guest teacher reduction was manageable as sites can supplement with site funds.
